business_summary: Mitani Corporation engages in the information systems, construction materials, energy, lifestyle-related business and development business in Japan and internationally. The company offers various software, including ERP, image-processing systems, and information infrastructure environments; sells, builds, and supports computer-related systems for academic institutions; and support investment and management of IT projects for academic institutions, including educational systems, portals, portfolios, and account management. It also distributes information and communication technology related products; manages e-commerce website; develop systems for image processing and analysis; and supplies cement, soil improvement materials, ALC walls, spancrete, assembly manhole, fresh concrete, aggregates, extruded cement panels, hume pipes, concrete-based secondary products and admixtures, steel equipment, flooring material, interior construction, and fireproofing construction, as well as grating and other construction materials for roads, steel products, and other applications. In addition, the company offers gasoline, kerosene, crude oil, asphalt, liquid natural gas, coal, unsaturated polyester resins, gas oil, A/C heavy oil, lubricants, liquefied petroleum gas, general pressurized gases, plastics, secondary plastic products, kerosene heat pumps, household fuel cells; paints, colorants, and fertilizers; chemical products; and light equipment. Further, it provides construction equipment, store equipment, elevators, parking lots, solar power generation, hot-water pipes, and power generation products; and housing fixtures, water supply and drainage, HVAC, equipment for gas stations, office supplies, floor-panel heating, snow-melting facilities, real estate brokerage, leisure-related products, restaurants, lease services, and FRP-based swimming pools. The company was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Mitani Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 정보 시스템, 건축 자재, 에너지, 라이프 스타일 관련 사업 및 개발 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 ERP, 이미지 처리 시스템, 정보 인프라 환경을 포함한 다양한 소프트웨어를 제공합니다. 교육 기관을 위한 컴퓨터 관련 시스템을 판매, 구축 및 지원합니다. 교육 시스템, 포털, 포트폴리오, 계정 관리 등 학술 기관을 위한 IT 프로젝트의 투자 및 관리를 지원합니다. 또한 정보통신기술 관련 제품을 유통합니다. 전자상거래 웹사이트를 관리합니다. 이미지 처리 및 분석 시스템을 개발합니다. 시멘트, 토양개량자재, ALC벽체, 스팬크리트, 조립맨홀, 프레시콘크리트, 골재, 시멘트압출패널, 흄관, 콘크리트 기반 2차제품 및 혼화재, 철강장비, 바닥재, 내장재, 방화건축물, 그레이팅 및 도로용 건축자재, 철강제품 등을 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 휘발유, 등유, 원유, 아스팔트, 액화천연가스, 석탄, 불포화 폴리에스테를 제공합니다.
